settings.name: AFK
settings.desc: AFK ends with the first message sent at least one minute after going AFK. Change who can use this command in `Server Settings` > `Integrations` > `Ayako` > `afk`

maxLetters.name: Max. Letters/Symbols
maxLetters.desc: The most letters or symbols an AFK status can have.

prefix.name: Prefix
prefix.desc: Go AFK by message, e.g. `,` for `,afk brb`, or a user mention like `<@ID>`. Leave empty to only use the Server's Ayako prefix.

ignoredChannels.name: Ignored Channels
ignoredChannels.desc: Messages in these channels don't end AFK.

settings.prefixAdvert: Prefix commands need a bot that can read messages. Add [Ayako]({{main}}) or [Ayako Ticketing]({{invite}}) to this Server.

errors.maxLetters: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
errors.prefix: A prefix can have at most {{max}} characters and no spaces, or be a user mention like `<@ID>`.
